use_case_name: Copy Uncompressed Files to Another Location

claims.content: The user copies uncompressed files from the PeaZip file manager to another location on the computer system via drag-and-drop, where the files are automatically copied without extraction.

goal.raw_text: The user copies uncompressed files from the PeaZip file manager to another location on the computer system via drag-and-drop, where the files are automatically copied without extraction.

claims.content: User
PeaZip application is running and the file manager interface is active.
The files to be copied are not contained within a compressed archive (i.e., they are uncompressed or stored without compression).
The operating system supports drag-and-drop operations between applications and system locations.
The user drags and drops uncompressed files from the PeaZip file manager interface to a location on the computer system.

trigger.raw_text: The user drags and drops uncompressed files from the PeaZip file manager interface to a location on the computer system.

claims.content: The user selects one or more uncompressed files within the PeaZip file manager interface.
The user initiates a drag operation on the selected files.
The user drags the files over the desired destination folder or location in the computer system (outside the application).
The user releases the mouse button to drop the files at the target location.
PeaZip automatically copies the uncompressed files to the destination location without extracting or decompressing them.
The uncompressed files are copied to the destination location on the computer system.
The files are copied without being extracted or decompressed.
